title: Hour markers off (for finger pricks only?) by ~ 10 minutes
symptom: When syncing a Contour BG meter via BT without a CGM, a blood sample taken at 14:46 is displayed near the 15:00 marker, off by about 10 minutes. The upper range limit line also appears shifted beyond the 15:00 marker. The offset appears in both portrait and landscape modes, with markers shifted to the left by ~10 minutes.
cause: The marker is intentionally placed in advance (about 15 minutes) to account for the delay between blood and tissue glucose. This behavior is intended, but there is no switch to change it.
evidence_quote: The marker is placed 15 (?) minutes in advance to take the delay between blood and tissue glucose into account. In your case this is not needed but AFAIK there is no switch to change the behaviour.
